description: Mints a portable sanity attestation: a signed token binding an agent_id to a statement's sanity-check results. Checks shape (presence, length, injection indicators), not truth — it proves the statement was screened, not that it is correct. The token is HMAC-signed upstream with a production secret; verification is via qm_attest_verify, and the token itself is not proof. Free, anonymous. Example: agent_id="agent-7", statement="I will proceed after verifying the source" returns agent_id, at, token, and checks; all four fields go to qm_attest_verify to confirm the signature.
name: qm_attest
